units: <cite ref="Shabbat 104a:10">Sabb. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>גוֹפו טימא אר̇חם עליו</he> though he defiled his body, I shall have mercy &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 104a:11">Ib.</cite> <cite ref="C01224"><he>ג״ר ד״ק</he></cite>: <he>אם … ג̇ור̇ בד̇וק̇</he> (Ar. <he>גֵֹּר̇ בד̇וק̇ תהיה</he>) if thou doest so (be chaste), dwell thou in heaven (a dweller … shalt thou be).
